Name: Radical Galactykes - a Livestock Mod
Author: Radicalvice
Description:
[size=3][b]Summary:[/b][/size]

"Radical Galactykes" adds a brand new coop animal - the galactyke. Simply put, it's an alien. The space-y kind.
How'd they get here? As always, Stardew Valley proves to be the scariest place in the world by attracting itty bitty meteors that aren't meteors at all, but rather offspring.
Said offspring are taken and sold to the farmer by, who else, a particularly mortified Marnie, for a rather hefty price, given they're ALIENS.

Starting off timid and mundane, the average galactyke hatchling is protected by a meteorite-like carapace, barely floating around with a flickering aura.
Fast-forward a week and now you have a gaseous maniac that resides in one of your coops, producing the following products:

[list]
[*][b]Star Shards[/b] - It appears the origin of this specific mineral has finally been discovered. That's fun.
[*][b]Energy Tonic[/b] - Upon having three hearts with a galactyke, earning it's loyalty, there's a chance you'll receive an unusual gift. I'm sure Harvey or Maru won't notice.
[/list][size=3][b]
Installation:[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url];
[*]Install [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url]﻿;﻿
[*]I would also recommend you to install [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿ and [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/29997]Livestock Bazaar[/url]﻿﻿;
[*]As usual, download the main .zip file of this mod and extract it within Stardew's mod folder.
[/list]Like with most other livestock mods, if you want these beasts gone from your game, simply delete the mod from the aforementioned folder. The best part? Any item you received from these dudes will stay, as they're all Vanilla.
